item.title: [Message Center] MC1557766 Microsoft Viva: Introducing Interactive Insights in the A365 Business Analytics app
item.description:
Microsoft Viva introduces Interactive Insights in Agent 365 Business Analytics, enabling eligible users to explore AI adoption and usage via natural-language queries without manual reporting. Rolling out from November 2026 to April 2027, it respects existing data permissions and offers AI-powered summaries and visualizations within authorized scopes.

item.description:
Access Management for Agent 365 Business Analytics centralizes role and permission assignments for admins, combining permission sets and data partitions into access policies. It simplifies management, supports existing roles, and syncs delegation access. Rollout begins January 2027. Admins should review current settings and prepare for policy setup.
